## Requirement statement

State the requirement the architecture must satisfy — one short, dated, forward-stated claim. Not a narrative of how you found the gap.

## Driver

Which Layer-4 federal standard or policy obligates this? Tag at least one Family: `AI`, `CLOUD`, `ON-PREM`, or `CROSS-CUTTING`. See `Layer-Model.md` for the tag definitions.

## Corpus evidence (optional)

Does a genuine, linkable Layer-3 source corroborate this empirically? Cite it, and confirm it has (or will have) an entry in `Knowledge-Source-References.md`. Corpus evidence is evidentiary only — it never substitutes for a Driver citation.

## Related ADRs

Does an existing ADR already address this, partially or fully? If not, this will be logged as an open requirement.
